tamNhinSuMenh.title: Orientation Compass
tamNhinSuMenh.hero: "Igniting human potential, creating global digital citizens."

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: Digital Education Ecosystem
vision.text: ERG aims to become a pioneering technology education ecosystem where science and technology are applied extensively to redefine how people learn and work. We create a borderless learning space, using technology as a driving force for breakthroughs, unleashing innovative thinking, nurturing creative capacity, and equipping skills so that each individual can confidently conquer the digital future.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Practical Study - Practical Work
mission.text: ERG carries the mission of closing the digital divide through high-quality technology education. We equip learners with a solid foundation, modern technological thinking, and problem-solving abilities in the digital world. ERG's training programs always update the latest technological trends, helping students not only master skills but also be ready to adapt, innovate, and confidently conquer the global labor market.

cta.title: This educational philosophy is built on 5 core values

community.title: Social Responsibility
community.content: ERG contributes to the sustainable development of society through international training programs, enhancing technology skills for the community.

quality.title: Superior Quality
quality.content: ERG is committed to providing the best quality products and services by ensuring optimal success rates and superior service experiences.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.content: ERG builds a teamwork environment where everyone shares knowledge, experience and grows together.

integrity.title: Customer-Centric
integrity.content: ERG puts the interests and satisfaction of customers as the top priority in aspects of understanding, quality improvement, transparency, and keeping commitments.

innovation.title: Innovative Spirit
innovation.content: Technology is not just a tool, but a driving force to transform education. ERG promotes the spirit of innovation in each solution, encouraging creative thinking.

cta.title: Ready to join ERG?
cta.desc: We always welcome talents who share our values to create the future of education.

intro.title: Aspiration in the Digital Era
intro.content: Amidst the wave of strong digital transformation, when global education faces demands for innovation to keep pace with the times, {brand} was born with a great aspiration: to turn technology into a sustainable bridge between knowledge and people.
intro.highlight: "We don't just teach technology, we use technology to unleash human potential."

breakdown.title: "Edu + Rise + Global" – {brand} carries the mission of unleashing intellectual potential through smart and comprehensive education solutions.
breakdown.subtitle: Founded by dedicated educators and deep technology experts, {brand} is the intersection of progressive educational thinking and breakthrough creative capabilities in the digital era.
